nodes.title: Squad Woo Commerce Plugin
nodes.summary: This section introduces the Squad Woo Commerce Plugin for collecting payments on WordPress sites using the Squad Payment Gateway.

nodes.title: Overview
nodes.summary: Provides an overview of Squad's secure payment gateway, its global reach, and the various payment methods supported for WooCommerce.

nodes.title: Benefits of using Squad payment gateway
nodes.summary: Outlines the key advantages of integrating the Squad payment gateway, including ease of use, fraud detection, and customer support.

nodes.title: Plugin Configuration
nodes.summary: Details the necessary steps and settings for configuring the Squad WooCommerce plugin within the WordPress admin dashboard.

nodes.title: To configure the plugin
nodes.summary: Provides a step-by-step guide for enabling and setting up the Squad Payment Gateway, including entering API keys and webhook instructions.

nodes.title: Image Descriptions
nodes.summary: Describes the visual aids provided, which illustrate the Squad settings page, a sample order page, and the Squad Payment Modal.

nodes.title: Download
nodes.summary: Offers a direct link for users to download the Squad Payment Gateway plugin for their WordPress WooCommerce site.
